jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Data
jobs.description:
At BuildOps, we build software for modern commercial contractors, from service management through project delivery. We care deeply about the mission and look for people who are driven, self motivated, and excited by fast moving, high ownership environments.

Data sits at the center of BuildOps' AI first strategy. The operational data our customers generate on BuildOps is a long term advantage, but only if it is clean, reliable, and well governed. As Director of Engineering, Data, you will build and lead our unified Data & AI engineering function. You will own the platforms, pipelines, quality standards, and operating discipline that power AI and ML products and help customers trust BuildOps as their system of record.

Reporting to the CTO, you will help define BuildOps' data strategy over the next three to five years and shape how we build data powered products. This is a foundational leadership role for someone who can think long term about architecture while staying close to the work. You have built and scaled data organizations before and know how to take a team from early stage scrappiness to operational excellence.

What You'll Do

Own BuildOps' data platform and architecture end to end, including ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and an ML and streaming strategy that evolves with the business and scales efficiently
Build scalable, repeatable customer and partner data onboarding capabilities that bring data into BuildOps quickly and reliably, reducing time to first value
Run data systems with production grade discipline, including monitoring, alerting, SLAs, incident response, lineage, freshness, and clear ownership for critical datasets
Create the data foundation required for AI and ML products, with accurate, well documented inputs today and the right training, inference, and feature infrastructure as those products mature
Establish governance that supports speed, including access controls, data classification, audit trails, PII handling, and practical data contracts that teams can depend on
Hire, develop, and lead a strong data engineering team, and establish the right operating rhythms across planning, on call, and stakeholder intake

What We Look For

10+ years in data or software engineering, including experience building and scaling teams of 10+ engineers, with a track record of hiring well, growing leaders, and leading through managers as well as individual contributors
Deep hands on experience with modern data platforms, including a cloud warehouse or lakehouse such as Snowflake or Databricks, dbt and ELT patterns, orchestration tools like Airflow, and streaming technologies such as Kafka or Kinesis, with AWS experience strongly preferred
Direct experience building data systems that support production ML use cases, not just analytics, with an understanding of feature stores, training data, real time inference, and the tradeoffs involved in building versus buying ML platform capabilities
A track record of operational excellence in data, including monitoring, SLAs, incident response, and data quality practices applied with the same rigor as customer facing systems
Experience delivering customer facing data products such as reporting, analytics, or APIs in B2B SaaS environments where performance, reliability, and trust matter
Strong architectural judgment, including when to build, when to buy, how to design for change, and how to sequence investments behind validated needs instead of overbuilding
A pragmatic approach to governance, with security and compliance built in, documentation and contracts that stay current, and access models that balance control with self service
Early stage or scale up experience in Series B through D companies is a plus, and experience in vertical SaaS or construction tech is helpful but not required

Who You Are

A builder who is comfortable with ambiguity and greenfield work, and can move quickly, ship an MVP, and still make sound decisions for long term scale
Both hands on and strategic, willing to write code, debug issues, and carry operational responsibility when needed while maintaining a clear multi year vision
You know how to influence across Product, Engineering, GTM, Finance, and the executive team, build trust, communicate clearly, and push back when priorities are misaligned
Able to translate technical decisions into business impact and business goals into technical direction
You have seen this stage of growth before and know what good looks like in a high growth data organization

Compensation

$198,000 - $265,000 base salary range + annual bonus + meaningful equity

What we offer:

Generous equity grant, become an owner in our company!
A comprehensive benefits package
Flexible PTO and hybrid work schedules
One-time work-from-home allowance
Hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, Toronto, and Raleigh with hybrid work schedules and lunch provided for in-office days
Company events and team-building activities, both in-person and virtual
Fast-paced, collaborative, and dynamic work environment
Opportunities for growth and career advancement
Chance to work with cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions
The chance to get in on the ground floor and build something truly groundbreaking for ourselves and our amazing customers

We welcome applicants from across the U.S. where we are registered to do business and able to support employment. Currently, this excludes the following states: Alaska, Hawaii, Kentucky, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming. This list is based solely on operational and compliance considerations and is reviewed from time to time as our footprint grows.

About BuildOps

Join BuildOps, the largest commercial trade platform in the country, as we transform the multi-billion dollar commercial contracting industry!

We’re not just talking incremental improvements—we’re talking a full-scale revolution, empowering the hardworking heroes who build and maintain the infrastructure that keeps our world running. See why contractors choose Buildops here.

This is your chance to be part of a rocketship. We’re fresh off a $1 billion valuation and a $127M Series C funding round (part of over $275M raised to date) led by industry-leading investors like Meritech Capital, BOND, and SE Ventures, backed by Schneider Electric (Reuters, TechCrunch, LA Business Journal) . Our latest investors join our team of industry heavyweights like Next47, former Twitter CEO Dick Costolo, former Salesforce President Gavin Patterson, and Boost Mobile CEO Stephen Stokols. Their investment is fueling our aggressive growth and our commitment to equipping contractors with AI-driven tools to conquer chaos, boost efficiency, skyrocket profitability, and ultimately, deliver exceptional service.

At BuildOps, we’re changing the game and doing the best work of our careers. You’ll be a key player in a company that’s truly making a difference for the backbone of our economy. If you’re ready to tackle big challenges, work with a passionate team, and build something extraordinary, BuildOps is the place for you. 🚀

jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 279233

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Scotiabank's Global Technology Enterprise Platforms (GTEP) provides secure, resilient and efficient technology infrastructure that enable the Bank's business strategy and customer experience. The Strategic Portfolio Office (SPO) supports GTEP leadership through integrated strategy, financial management, performance transparency, portfolio governance and enterprise-wide transformation.

The Director, Financial Performance & Efficiency
is responsible for leading the financial performance management and efficiency agenda across GTEP. The role provides an integrated view of financial results, outlook, productivity and value delivery, enabling leaders to make timely, fact-based decisions and deliver against financial commitments.

The role is accountable for strengthening planning, forecasting, performance reporting and cost governance; identifying and advancing sustainable efficiency opportunities; and translating financial and operational information into clear executive insights. This includes partnering across GTEP, Finance, Procurement and other stakeholders to improve transparency, accountability and execution.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Financial Planning & Performance Management
Lead integrated financial planning, forecasting and performance management across GTEP, aligning financial commitments with strategic priorities and delivery plans.
Establish a clear and consistent view of actuals, outlook, variances, risks and opportunities, with defined ownership and actions to close performance gaps.
Develop executive-level reporting and insights that connect financial results with operational drivers, investment choices and business outcomes.
Strengthen financial governance, management routines and decision support to improve predictability, transparency and accountability.

Efficiency & Value Optimization
Define and advance the GTEP efficiency agenda, including sustainable cost reduction, demand management, productivity improvement and reinvestment opportunities.
Identify, assess and prioritize efficiency opportunities using financial, operational and benchmark information; establish baselines, targets, benefits and delivery plans.
Track realized and forecast benefits, challenge delivery gaps and ensure efficiency commitments are supported by credible actions and evidence.
Promote disciplined cost management and value-based decision making across the organization without compromising resilience, risk management or service outcomes.

Governance, Reporting & Insights
Own the financial performance and efficiency reporting framework, including measures, definitions, data quality standards, controls and executive reporting cadence.
Provide concise, forward-looking insights and recommendations to GTEP leaders, highlighting material trends, trade-offs, decisions and required interventions.
Improve the consistency and usability of management information by simplifying reporting, reducing manual effort and enabling greater automation where appropriate.
Support leadership forums, planning cycles and portfolio reviews with decision-ready analysis and clear accountability for follow-through.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management
Build trusted partnerships with GTEP leaders, Finance, Procurement, workforce teams, portfolio owners and other enterprise stakeholders.
Influence senior stakeholders to align financial choices, operational priorities and efficiency actions with GTEP and Bank objectives.
Foster a culture of ownership, constructive challenge, collaboration, continuous improvement and measurable value delivery.
Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team with strong capabilities in financial management, analytics, business advisory and executive communication.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:

University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline; a professional accounting or finance designation is an asset.
10+ years of progressive experience in financial management, business performance, strategic planning, cost optimization, technology finance or a related field within a large, complex organization.
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale planning, forecasting, management reporting and efficiency programs.
Strong financial acumen with the ability to connect financial results to operational drivers, strategic choices and measurable business outcomes.
Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience translating complex data into clear executive insights and recommendations.
Experience establishing performance measures, financial governance, benefit tracking and management routines that improve accountability and execution.
Strong stakeholder management, influencing and executive communication capabilities, including the ability to constructively challenge senior leaders.
Demonstrated leadership experience building and developing high-performing teams in a matrixed enterprise environment.
Knowledge of technology infrastructure, enterprise platforms, financial services or regulated environments is an asset.

What's in it for you?

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.
Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days and benefits will start on day one.
Dynamic Ecosystem - Free tea & coffee, universal washrooms, and lots of space for team collaboration.
Community Engagement - We offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs such as hackathons.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

About Us

Nova Scotia is rich in natural resources - including biodiversity, forests, geological resources, provincial parks and the land we manage. The Department of Natural Resources is responsible for the development, management, conversation and protection of forest, mineral, parks and wildlife resources and the administration of the province's crown land. Together, we are working with Nova Scotians to build a better future through sustainable natural resource management as we all benefit from the natural health and wealth of the province.

About Our Opportunity

As Director, Strategic Policy and Planning, you provide leadership in facilitating appropriate linkages between policy, program and delivery structures, and developing new inclusive approaches which will generate greater collective knowledge and enhance capacity for integrated, collaborative policy planning, legislative and regulatory development.

In addition, you provide strategic direction and oversight for the research, design, planning, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of department strategies and initiatives.

Further, you are responsible for directing a team of policy professionals, including maintaining appropriate relationships with central agencies (ECO, OSE, FTB), and directing and ensuring the quality of DNR and DOE submissions to Executive Council.

Primary Accountabilities

Lead and develop an effective, coordinated strategic planning infrastructure with associated policy, planning and regulatory management processes, change management, standards and guidelines for DNR/DOE.
Lead policy/planning initiatives, with an emphasis on those related to key natural resource and energy strategies.
Provide broad oversight for environmental scanning and analyses to monitor trends, identify gaps and risks in internal planning activities and to inform and stimulate discussion about future strategic directions and opportunities that might affect policy and planning decisions.
Provide oversight for the development and coordination of legislative planning and response during the Legislative Sessions of the House.
Oversee and directs the development of departmental Memos to Executive Council, R&Rs, legislative requests, Briefing Books, and all Committee appearances for DNR and DOE.
Provide a planned approach to increase internal capacity and build and sustain required skill sets of the team to meet current and future needs, ensuring the policy and planning team are properly resourced, motivated, empowered and have access to opportunities for growth and development.

You are an innovative policy leader with an educational background in policy development and administration (e.g. Public Administration) and have progressive senior leadership experience in a related field.

We also want to hear about your experience and achievements in maintaining professional and effective relationships, in leading and aligning teams, and in promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace.

Progressive experience within government, across a variety of Departments, is considered an asset.

Required competencies for this position include: Analytical Thinking, Strategic Orientation, Innovativeness, Adaptability and Flexibility, Initiative, Effective Interactive Communication, Partnering and Relationship Building, Intercultural and Diversity Proficiency.

Can you lead a modern planning evolution, with autonomy, harnessing platforms like Workday Adaptive Planning and Power BI while maintaining rock-solid financial governance, and serve as the vital bridge between long-term strategic models and frontline operational partners?

This is a highly visible leadership role within a premier multi-billion dollar organization. The Director, Corporate FP&A sits at the center of enterprise capital allocation and operational strategy. As the direct right hand to the Executive Director, you will step into a fluid organizational structure to build, optimize, and scale corporate planning, forecasting, and business-partnering processes.

If you are an agile builder, an optimizer, and an articulate business advisor with a track record of tangible corporate FP&A transformation, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for!

Why Join This Team?

- Executive Right-Hand & High Visibility: Serve as the strategic co-pilot to the Executive Director, acting as the primary liaison between long-term strategic financial modeling and embedded operational business partners, with frequent exposure to the executive leadership team.
- A True Builder’s Mandate: Inherit a fragmented spreadsheet landscape and enjoy a blank canvas to re-architect the entire planning lifecycle, streamlining 50+ models into automated, scalable planning workflows.
- Autonomous, Hands-Off Leadership: Work with a pragmatic, non-micromanaging leader who trusts the team, values open communication, and gives you complete autonomy to own, shape, and modernize the function.
- Modern Systems Evolution: Drive the evolution of the corporate planning stack, leveraging Oracle Financials, optimizing Workday Adaptive Planning, deploying Power BI executive dashboards, and testing predictive AI applications.

Exceptional Compensation & Total Rewards:

- Base salary between 160-200K
- Performance Bonus: 20% annual target
- Retirement & Pension: Up to 8% employer matching program
- Comprehensive Health & Wellness: 100% employer-sponsored health, dental, and vision coverage effective on Day One
- Industry-Leading Time Off: 4 weeks paid vacation + 5 personal days + Care Days
- Professional Growth: Full sponsorship for executive professional development, conferences, and annual CPA dues.

What You Will Do & Lead:

- Model Rationalization & FP&A Architecture: Take full ownership of the corporate planning ecosystem; audit, streamline, and consolidate over 50 legacy Excel workbooks into - standardized, driver-based planning templates and rolling forecasts.
- Strategic Business Partnering: Partner across high-volume commercial, operational, and capital divisions, translating operational drivers and volume throughput metrics into actionable financial models and strategic advice.
- Systems Modernization & Data Integrity: Maximize the value of enterprise tools—anchoring planning in Workday Adaptive Planning, reporting through Oracle, building executive Power BI dashboards, and laying the groundwork for predictive analytics.
- Capital & Operating Budget Oversight: Guide multi-year budgeting, variance analysis, sensitivity analysis, and scenario modeling across complex multi-million-dollar operational budgets and major capital investment programs.
- Team Leadership & Culture: Lead, mentor, and elevate a high-potential corporate FP&A team, instilling a culture of evidence-based analysis, intellectual curiosity, and proactive business advisory.

- Designation & Education: Active CPA and/or CFA designation is mandatory; an MBA or Master’s degree in Finance/Business is considered a strong competitive asset.
- Progressive Leadership Experience: 10+ years of progressive corporate finance and FP&A experience, with at least 7+ years successfully managing, mentoring, and scaling corporate finance teams.
- Proven Track Record of FP&A Transformation: Demonstrable, evidence-based achievements taking manual, Excel-heavy environments and successfully standing up structured EPM/planning frameworks (e.g., Workday Adaptive Planning, Anaplan, Prophix, or Hyperion).
- Operational Volume & Driver Expertise: Demonstrated experience modeling complex, asset-heavy, or high-throughput operations (logistics, freight, supply chain, utilities, healthcare, public infrastructure, or large-scale multi-entity corporate environments).
- Advanced Systems & Financial Modeling Acumen: Expert-level financial modeling and Excel skills (Power Query/Pivot), paired with hands-on experience in modern BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) and enterprise ERP platforms (Oracle, SAP).
- Executive Presence & High Autonomy: A poised, articulate communicator who simplifies complex financial narratives for executive audiences, challenges assumptions with data, and thrives with complete end-to-end accountability.

About Us

Nasdaq (Nasdaq: NDAQ) is a leading global provider of trading, clearing, exchange technology, listing, information and public company services. Nasdaq is home to approximately 4,000 total listings with a market value of approximately $15 trillion. To learn more, visit: http://www.nasdaq.com

The Team

Group Risk Management (GRM) collaborates with businesses as a trusted advisor, facilitating well-informed decisions that support Nasdaq’s strategic objectives. GRM manages and continues to enhance the Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Control, Business Continuity, Crisis Management, and Corporate Insurance frameworks and programs. These programs facilitate the identification, assessment, monitoring, and treatment and reporting of all types of risks, Nasdaq faces.

GRM is seeking an ERM Director supporting the Anti-Financial Crime Division’s – Verafin business. Establish effective risk governance including board approved risk policies, risk appetite, and risk committee/forums.

Serve as a risk management subject matter expert for the business.
